mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.2% signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 7.5% signals a weak labor market, which typically precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and PAYEMS decline by more than 0.5% from their 3-month averages, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle economic expansion, housing starts (HOUST) above 950 thousand units signal overbuilding and potential policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 950 and the economy is in a late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 98.5 indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 98.5, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 0.3% signals rising price pressures that may prompt central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is rising, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 134,000 thousand persons signals weakening labor market conditions, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS < 134000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
